title: Avila Core Signature v0.1 draft
description: A detached Ed25519 signature over one other document's digest (ADR-0015). Bound into a case package like any other document, with role `signature`. A signature proves possession of a key at signing time; it does not establish the correctness of what was signed, qualification, review, or regulatory suitability.

signed_document.description: What was signed: a role (`manifest`, `execution_receipt`, or a log line's own role), an identifier within that role's namespace (the case id for a manifest, the receipt's document_id for a receipt), and the exact digest the signature covers.

key_id.description: The SHA-256 of the signing key's public key bytes, hex encoded (no `sha256:` prefix, distinguishing a key identifier from a content digest).

signature_hex.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the raw digest bytes named by signed_document.sha256, hex encoded.
